title: Architecture
description: A data architecture: the eight independent feature flags of docs/design/simulation_spec.md section 5 (ADR-0005) and the labelling method. Presets A, B and C are data under scenarios/architectures/. There is no ninth flag: an unknown key under flags is rejected, and a new flag needs its own Proposed ADR.

system_issued_id.description: On: the key is issued by the system at label creation. Off: typed or handwritten.

two_clocks.description: On: sampled_at and measured_at are stored separately. Off: one time is stored, the measured time.

available_at.description: On: each row carries when it became knowable. Off: queries see rows as of now.

instrument_state_snapshot.description: On: the run links instrument, calibration and reagent lot. Off: a free-text analyzer name at most.

append_only_versions.description: On: a correction, rerun or reprocess creates a version. Off: overwrite in place.

write_time_keys.description: On: sample_id, unit_id and batch_id are fixed at write time and never re-keyed. Off: unit and batch are attached later by a time join.

ingest_idempotency.description: On: source event id and key, duplicates and replays are no-ops. Off: duplicates double count.

audit_trail.description: On: who, when and what changed, with operator id. Off: no history.

labelling.description: The L2 labelling method (spec section 2.2); set independently of the flags.

capture_path.description: How a result an instrument has produced becomes a record (spec section 5, 'Capture path'; ADR-0014): typed by hand from the screen or printout, or parsed from the raw device file. A setting, not a ninth flag. The preset default (A manual_transcription, B and C adapter_ingest) is inert while the scenario's raw_layer is off; a scenario may override it.

source_of_record.description: The system of record for routine in-process results (spec section 5, A056). A setting, not a flag; nothing in S2a reads it.
